statements.expire:
UPDATE delivery_planned_queue SET state = 'dead', claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL,
  last_error = 'the claim of its last attempt expired before its handler finished', updated_at = now()
WHERE state = 'claimed' AND claim_expires_at <= now() AND attempts > $1
statements.claim:
WITH due AS (
  SELECT id FROM delivery_planned_queue
  WHERE (state = 'ready' AND due_at <= now()) OR (state = 'claimed' AND claim_expires_at <= now())
  ORDER BY due_at, id
  LIMIT $1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE delivery_planned_queue AS q SET state = 'claimed', attempts = q.attempts + 1, claim_token = gen_random_uuid(),
  claim_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $2), updated_at = now()
FROM due WHERE q.id = due.id
RETURNING q.id::text, q.claim_token::text, q.attempts, q.order_id, q.drop_at, q.wait, q.meet_at, q.grace
statements.complete:
UPDATE delivery_planned_queue SET state = 'done', claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'
statements.fail:
UPDATE delivery_planned_queue SET
  state = CASE WHEN attempts > $3 THEN 'dead' ELSE 'ready' END,
  due_at = CASE WHEN attempts > $3 THEN due_at ELSE now() + make_interval(secs => $4) END,
  last_error = $5, claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'
RETURNING state
statements.extend:
UPDATE delivery_planned_queue SET claim_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $3), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'
statements.release:
UPDATE delivery_planned_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = GREATEST(attempts - 1, 0), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND claim_token = $2::uuid AND state = 'claimed'
